summary: 60-year-old Omaha woman took a 20-ft tumbling fall when she slipped below a pullout on the lower section of Old Fall River Road in Rocky Mountain National Park, suffering serious injuries; NPS SAR team provided advanced medical care and conducted a technical rescue, lowering her ~60-70 ft down a scree field to Endovalley Picnic Area; Estes Health Ambulance assisted; UCHealth Lifeline Air Ambulance flew her to Medical Center of the Rockies
location: Old Fall River Road, Rocky Mountain National Park (lower section, below a pullout)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: Incident Friday afternoon 2020-08-07 per NPS news release (release dated Aug 7, 2020); Old Fall River Road closed ~3 hours, reopened 1:30 p.m.; run-948 insert via NPS RMNP compendium tail review
